title: Canonical cyclic geometric sheets of a constant extension
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], an integer $m\ge1$, and a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $X_0$. Use the constant-extension datum, model $X_{0,m}$, original-base model $X_{(0,m)}$, distinguished sheet $j:X_{0,m}\times_{k_m}k\to X_{(0,m)}\times_{k_0}k$, and canonical geometric-fibre isomorphism $e:X_{0,m}\times_{k_m}k\xrightarrow{\sim}X_0\times_{k_0}k$ of [def-dl-a1-constant-extension-data]. Put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, $Y=X_{(0,m)}\times_{k_0}k$, and let $H:Y\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ be geometric Frobenius for the original $k_0$-model [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. For every $i\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$ define the canonical cyclic sheet map $h_i:X\to Y$ by $h_i=H^i\circ j\circ e^{-1}$. These are scheme morphisms; no $k$-linearity is imposed.
